events.speaker: FOMC Statement
events.text: Downside risks softening labor demand banking fragility and safe-haven credit stress support patient easing.

events.speaker: FOMC Statement
events.text: Inflation remains elevated and requires restrictive policy tightening and real rate vigilance.

events.speaker: Chair Powell
events.text: We are vigilant against persistent upside inflation pressures and firming nominal yields.

events.speaker: FOMC Statement
events.text: Another hike and firming restrictive stance remain appropriate while overheating persists.

events.speaker: Chair Powell
events.text: Tightening and restrictive recalibration will continue until inflation is moving down.

events.speaker: Chair Powell
events.text: Accommodative easing is premature while persistent inflation and elevated yields remain.

events.speaker: FOMC Statement
events.text: Moderating growth slowdown headwinds and stagflation tail-risk justify accommodative liquidity support.

events.speaker: Chair Powell
events.text: Disinflation softening employment conditions and banking stress call for patient policy recalibration.

events.speaker: Chair Powell
events.text: Slowdown risks fragile demand headwinds and systemic contagion support a cut and accommodative stance.

events.speaker: Chair Powell
events.text: Easing inflation pressures downside unemployment risks and fiscal fragility allow patient support.
